topic: Rainbow halos around lights with eye pain/headache: urgent

youtube.title: Rainbow halos + eye pain? This is urgent 🌈⚠️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Rainbow rings around lights, with eye pain and headache? This can be an emergency.
விளக்கைச் சுற்றி வானவில் வளையம், கண் வலியா? உடனே கண் மருத்துவரிடம்!

• Fluid inside the eye normally drains out; in some people the drain can suddenly get blocked.
• Then eye pressure shoots up: this is acute angle-closure glaucoma.
• Sign 1: halos or rainbow rings around lights, with blurred vision.
• Sign 2: severe eye pain and headache, often on one side.
• Sign 3: red eye with nausea or vomiting (often mistaken for migraine or stomach upset).
• Without quick treatment it can cause permanent vision loss. See an eye specialist the same day.
• Risk is higher after 40 and in long-sighted people: get regular eye checks.

gmb.text: Seeing rainbow halos around lights together with eye pain or headache can be an emergency. In some people, the fluid inside the eye suddenly stops draining and the eye pressure rises quickly. This is called acute angle-closure glaucoma. Three warning signs: halos or rainbow rings around lights with blurred vision; severe eye pain and headache, often on one side; and a red eye with nausea or vomiting, which people often mistake for a migraine or stomach upset. Without quick treatment it can cause permanent vision loss, so see an eye specialist the same day. Risk is higher after 40 and in long-sighted people, so regular eye checks matter.
